nodes.prompt:
TASK: Fix the Ferryx terminal renderer lifecycle race where `destroy(sessionId)` occurs while `getOrCreate()` is awaiting renderer creation, so a stale completed promise cannot repopulate `instances`, subscriptions, or the LRU cache after the tab/session has closed.
DELIVERABLE: Modify only `ui/src/lib/terminalHostManager.ts` and `ui/src/lib/terminalHostManager.test.ts` with the smallest strict TypeScript solution and a valid RED→GREEN test. Return exact changed files, RED/ GREEN transcripts, and lifecycle reasoning.
SCOPE: Do not change TerminalPane, workspace code, event bus, Rust, remote/mobile protocol, package manifests, or unrelated dirty files. Inspect current implementation first. Preserve all existing batching, pending output overflow, visible ref-count, LRU, replay, and PTY-preservation behavior.
REQUIRED BEHAVIOR: A renderer creation invalidated by `destroy` must dispose its newly allocated frontend resources once it resolves and must not be inserted into `instances` or LRU, retain an output subscription, or cancel/remove a newer pending creation for the same session ID. A subsequent legitimate `getOrCreate` for that same session ID must still work. No backend PTY close/spawn/IPC call belongs in this frontend fix.
RED PROOF: Add a deterministic test that delays the renderer creation promise (using the existing test mocks/controllable seam), invokes `getOrCreate`, calls `destroy` before resolving creation, then resolves it. The test must fail before the fix because `getInstance(sessionId)` becomes defined or the stale renderer remains live. It must also prove a subsequent fresh create succeeds. Run `bun run --cwd ui test -- terminalHostManager` and capture the failure before production edit.
GREEN PROOF: Implement the smallest typed invalidation/generation mechanism. Rerun the same command to green, then run it one final time after every mutation. No sleeps, no `any`, no type assertions, no test-only production API.
VERIFY: Check diagnostics on both changed files if available. STOP WHEN stale pending creation cannot resurrect a renderer, all host-manager tests pass, and no test process remains running.
